items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: I know the man who had sent him for him to play, who he was playing with over there, the man's name was Minor Brown.

ctx.x: You all called him Lazy Daddy. No.

I know the man who had sent him for him to play, who he was playing with over there, the man's name was Minor Brown. But I don't know the name of the band because I'm not good on remembering too long. It's different things.
It's hard to remember all those things.
